Play rising tones while the finger moves, a higher tone when an action is reached.
Actions for the volume up and down keys
Read new notifications aloud, choose what is said, and whether to read them when the screen is off. Incoming calls are always read.
What to read in a notification
Choose which parts of a notification are read, together or separately.
Shows a short message for every key press that reaches Nika: what the key is and whether it was used. Turn it on to find out why a key does not work.
Swipes from the bottom and top edges, like on an iPhone, with separate actions for the left and right side

Swipe up from the bottom edge or down from the top edge with one finger. A short and a long swipe each run an action of your choice, separately for the left and the right half of the screen. This switch does not affect the edge gestures from the sides.

Swipes from the left and right edges, with separate actions for the upper and lower half of the screen

Swipe with one finger from the left edge to the right or from the right edge to the left. A short and a long swipe each run an action of your choice, separately for the upper and the lower half of the screen. This switch does not affect the iPhone-style gestures.

Shows a short message at every touch: where it was, whether it is in an edge band and what the swipe did. Turn it on to find out why a gesture does not work.
Speech volume with a finger on the screen

On: hold one finger on the screen and press volume up or down to change the screen reader\'s volume. Off: the volume keys always change the media volume, so the screen reader follows the media volume.
